## Services & Technologies
- Live Stock Feed: https://flow.tru-saas.com/api/public/stock?dealer=apex-wholesale-investments
- Vehicle Condition Reports: 114-point TruInspect VIR® certified inspection reports with 0-100 score
- Finance Simulations: TruRepay bank-grade instalment calculator (NCA compliant)
- Affordability Pre-qualification: TruAfford income vs expense qualifying tool
- Trade-in Valuations: TruValue market-related vehicle appraisal
- 360° Studio Walkarounds: TruLens TruOrbit 360° interactive view
- Qualified Lead Response: 1-Tap WhatsApp instant lead inquiry

## Key Pages & Schema Structure
- Home Page -> https://www.apexinvest.co.za/: Featured inventory, quick search, finance tools, trade-in booking
- Full Showroom -> https://www.apexinvest.co.za/stock.html: Filterable inventory search (Make, Body, Price, Transmission, Fuel)
- Vehicle Details -> https://www.apexinvest.co.za/vehicle/: Vehicle detail pages with 360° view, specs, VIR score, and deal calculator
- Sitemap -> https://www.apexinvest.co.za/sitemap.xml: Structured XML sitemap

## Consumer Guarantees
- All prices displayed are VAT-inclusive with itemised pricing breakdown and zero hidden admin surcharges.
- Schema.org structured data (AutoDealer, Car, Offer) implemented across all listings.
